== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth: Echo Corridor (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Hoth: Echo Corridor]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100685 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100685], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100685-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(233, 129, 1762, 2410)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>38c49f59293f680e9bebd044971c4ab3793fe37ae6c3964089f33a0b78b00ab4</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
